+// Patched (cleat-failable-patch.txt): one per thread, several threads `return ok;` at once (a data race on a shared
+// global otherwise). A one-element array, because the address of a thread-local isn't a constant to initialize a
+// pointer with: `*(_OUTPUT_PARAM)` is still a FailableResult lvalue, and a parameter of that name still shadows it
